access: Runs the owner's rclone binary (subprocess, argument lists only) for explicit file transfers against the remotes the owner configured with `rclone config`. Forge stores NO cloud credentials anywhere: the OAuth tokens live in rclone's own config file, created by the owner outside Forge; connectors.json may name only which rclone command to run. Remote targets are fenced by the project's .forge/cloudstore.json allowed prefixes (default: nothing allowed); local paths must resolve inside the project workspace.
description: Cloud storage via rclone (item #70, adopted — not built): list, read, download, upload and delete individual files on the owner's Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Nextcloud/WebDAV, S3 or any other rclone remote. Setup: install rclone, run `rclone config` once in a terminal, name the project's allowed remote prefixes in .forge/cloudstore.json, then enable this connector. No sync and no mirroring — explicit transfers only.
name: Cloud Storage (rclone)

tools.description: List what is stored at a cloud remote path, e.g. remote 'gdrive:Forge' or 'gdrive:Forge/docs'. FENCED: the path must be, or sit under, a prefix the project allows in .forge/cloudstore.json — an unlisted prefix is refused before rclone is ever called. Read-only.
tools.name: cloud_list

remote.description: Remote target in the form remote:path, e.g. 'gdrive:Forge/docs'

tools.description: Read ONE text file from a cloud remote into the conversation, e.g. remote 'gdrive:Forge/notes.txt'. Fenced like cloud_list. Size-capped (64 KB): a bigger file is refused with a pointer to cloud_download, and a binary file is refused in plain words — download those instead.
tools.name: cloud_read

remote.description: Remote file in the form remote:path, e.g. 'gdrive:Forge/notes.txt'

tools.description: Download ONE file from a cloud remote into the project: remote 'gdrive:Forge/report.pdf', local 'downloads/report.pdf' (project-relative; parent folders are created). The remote copy is untouched. Approval-gated: it writes a local file. Fenced like cloud_list.
tools.name: cloud_download

local.description: Destination path inside the project, e.g. 'downloads/report.pdf'

remote.description: Remote file in the form remote:path, e.g. 'gdrive:Forge/report.pdf'

tools.description: Upload ONE file from the project to a cloud remote: local 'report.pdf' (project-relative), remote 'gdrive:Forge/report.pdf'. A copy, not a move — the project file stays. Approval-gated. The remote destination is fenced like cloud_list.
tools.name: cloud_upload

local.description: Source path inside the project, e.g. 'report.pdf'

remote.description: Remote destination in the form remote:path, e.g. 'gdrive:Forge/report.pdf'

tools.description: Delete ONE file from a cloud remote, e.g. remote 'gdrive:Forge/old.txt'. Never a folder and never recursive — a folder target is refused. Approval-gated. Fenced like cloud_list.
tools.name: cloud_delete

remote.description: Remote file in the form remote:path, e.g. 'gdrive:Forge/old.txt'
